        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

class TaskC {
    void solve(Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
        long w = in.nextLong();
        long m = in.nextLong();
        int count = 1;
        long ww = w;
        ArrayList<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
        list.add(1);
        long tmp1 = 1, tmp2 = 1;
        long up = 2;
        while ((Math.pow(w, up) * (w * w - w - 1) + 1) / (w - 1) <= m)
            up++;
        up += 2;
        if (m == 1) {
            out.println("YES");
            return;
        }
        while (count <= up) {
            int size = list.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                tmp1 = ww + list.get(i);
                tmp2 = ww - list.get(i);
                if (tmp1 == m || tmp2 == m) {
                    out.println("YES");
                    return;
                }
                list.add((int) tmp1);
                list.add((int) tmp2);
            }
            ww *= w;
            count++;
        }
        out.println("NO");
    }
}
